concepts.name: 幕隙经典高帮
concepts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Generate a single photorealistic premium youth fashion sneaker concept for MOVERNO / 墨维诺, SS27. This is a visually faithful reference-based redesign. Image A is the silhouette and aesthetic reference. Image B is the approved MOVERNO gate emblem: preserve its upright geometry, two separate opposing curved leaves with a straight narrow central open gap, never rotate, distort or turn it into another symbol. Image C is the approved Motion Contour textile/panel pattern: preserve its long paired leaf-like chambers, narrow slit centers and staggered end-to-end repeat; reinterpret its surface finish according to the brief, not its geometry.
Output ONE shoe, not a pair, not a moodboard or comparison sheet. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Left shoe, outer side visible, heel on left and toe pointing right, restrained three-quarter view only 15 degrees off lateral and slightly elevated enough to see laces. Entire shoe with generous margins, shoe occupies about 78% canvas width. Warm-white seamless studio, soft contact shadow, precise commercial footwear photography, beautiful tactile material detail, sharp seams, realistic lace paths. The stance, toe shape, collar height, sole mass and upper-to-sole ratio must closely follow Image A. Add brand identity with considered panel placement and material craft. Sophisticated street fashion for 18–30 year olds.
No lettering, numbers, captions, watermarks, wordmarks or floating brand badges in the image. Remove the reference brand's lettering and distinctive logos; use only supplied MOVERNO emblem and pattern. No stars, lightning bolts, swooshes, circles containing logos, colored stripe brand marks, skulls, weapons or extra futuristic hardware. No bright multicolor, no rainbow holography, no medical or orthopedic shoe proportions. Natural physically plausible shape and premium editorial finish.

Specific direction: 幕隙经典高帮.
Keep the first reference's tall slim black canvas basketball high-top silhouette, gently rising narrow round toe, long lace opening, thin bone rubber foxing and bone toe cap. Matte dense obsidian canvas, slightly aged ivory flat laces, small brushed nickel eyelets and precise bone contrast stitches. Replace circular ankle badge with the exact upright gate emblem as a flat ivory leather inlay at the lateral ankle, about 28mm high, clean black central slit. Rear quarter carries a subtle graphite-on-black woven crop of the approved long chamber pattern covering just the rear 25% of the shaft, two tall repeat columns. Toe and forefoot stay quiet. Modernize the cap with a smooth asymmetric back edge and a fine vertical ribbed toe bumper; foxing has a shallow narrow recessed seam that stops before heel rather than the reference's wraparound black stripe. Slim youthful stance, NOT a boot or platform.
